Subject: Rendale Motorworks - Referral Required

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the Rendale Motorworks submission. I've reviewed the materials and everything we need is included—appreciate the complete package.

This risk requires referral to senior underwriting for the following reasons:

• Auto class requires management review
• Total insured value of $11.4M exceeds our standard class maximum
• Five-year loss history exceeds $250K

Before I escalate this, can you help me with a few questions?

1. What loss control measures have been implemented since the recent loss activity?
2. Can you provide details on the auto exposure (number of vehicles, radius, driver qualifications)?
3. Is the insured open to higher retentions to improve terms?

I'll work to get you a response within 3-5 business days once I have these answers.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
